acceptance: The failure message names the exit status, the signal and the elapsed time, pinned by a test with a fake process state
A macOS run of -race -count=200 under parallel load is recorded in the internal-phases-ship package note
Cancel still kills the whole process group; the package note records the cause
fix: First make the next red diagnosable. On failure, log the ProcessState (exit code, signal), the time from cancel() to exit, and kill -0 of the grandchild. Then fix the cause. If it is macOS group-kill timing, assert with a bounded poll that the group is gone, not with the shell exit status.
summary: Rank 3 of the flaky-test census (docs/research/flaky-tests-2026-10.md F4.3): 3 reds on macOS (0.36% of macOS jobs), about 175 runner minutes. Runs 39069306819 a1 (rerun green), 39262811729 (#997), 39392251222 (#1032); neither PR touches internal/phases/ship. Message: repocontract_cmd_unix_test.go:50: Wait = context canceled, want the shell killed by SIGKILL. exec.Cmd.Wait returns the context error only if the process status is success, so the shell exited 0 after cancel. The cause is not proven, so this item starts with a diagnosis and has no RED-first criterion.
title: TestCancelKillsTheProcessGroup_CancelReapsTheGrandchildToo flakes on macOS: Wait reports a clean exit after cancel
